parameters.jsCode: const d=$input.first()?.json??{};const p=(d.review_request&&typeof d.review_request==='object')?d.review_request:d;const miss=[];for(const k of ['task_id','project_id','artifact_id','artifact_revision']){if(typeof p[k]!=='string'||!p[k].trim())miss.push(k)}const requirements=Array.isArray(p.requirements)?p.requirements:[];if(requirements.length===0)miss.push('approved_requirements');const canon=p.canon&&typeof p.canon==='object'?p.canon:{};const bar=p.bar&&typeof p.bar==='object'?p.bar:{};const art=p.artifact&&typeof p.artifact==='object'?p.artifact:{};if(p.brief_approved!==true)miss.push('approved_brief');if(p.bar_approved!==true||!Array.isArray(bar.mechanics)||bar.mechanics.length<5||bar.mechanics.length>7)miss.push('approved_bar_5_to_7_mechanics');if(typeof p.benchmark_ref!=='string'||!p.benchmark_ref.trim())miss.push('accessible_benchmark');const pack={task_id:p.task_id??null,project_id:p.project_id??null,artifact_id:p.artifact_id??null,artifact_revision:p.artifact_revision??null,review_round:Number.isInteger(p.review_round)&&p.review_round>0?p.review_round:1,requirements,canon:{revision:canon.revision??null,rules:Array.isArray(canon.rules)?canon.rules:[]},bar:{revision:bar.revision??null,mechanics:Array.isArray(bar.mechanics)?bar.mechanics:[]},benchmark_ref:p.benchmark_ref??null,artifact:{kind:art.kind??'unknown',render_refs:Array.isArray(art.render_refs)?art.render_refs:[],text_ref:art.text_ref??null},missing:miss,safe_mode:'DRAFT_NO_LLM_NO_COST',untrusted_approval_ignored:true};return[{json:pack}];

const a=$input.all().map(i=>i.json);const roles=['REVIEW-REQ','REVIEW-SYSTEM','REVIEW-CRAFT'];const counts={};for(const r of a)counts[r.role]=(counts[r.role]??0)+1;const missing=roles.filter(k=>counts[k]!==1);const same=a.length===3&&a.every(x=>x.task_id===a[0].task_id&&x.artifact_id===a[0].artifact_id&&x.artifact_revision===a[0].artifact_revision&&x.review_round===a[0].review_round);const valid=a.length===3&&missing.length===0&&same;const verdicts=a.map(x=>({role:x.role,model:x.model,verdict:x.verdict,ready_for_future_review:x.ready_for_future_review,missing_inputs:x.missing_inputs,evidence:x.evidence,biggest_gap:x.biggest_gap}));const fail=a.filter(x=>x.verdict==='FAIL');const blocked=a.filter(x=>x.verdict==='BLOCKED');const passed=valid&&a.every(x=>x.verdict==='PASS');const status=!valid?'BLOCKED_INVALID_REVIEW_SET':fail.length?'CHANGES_REQUESTED':blocked.length?'BLOCKED_AWAITING_INTEGRATION':passed?'AWAITING_OWNER_APPROVAL':'BLOCKED_UNKNOWN_VERDICT';return[{json:{task_id:a[0]?.task_id??null,artifact_id:a[0]?.artifact_id??null,artifact_revision:a[0]?.artifact_revision??null,review_round:a[0]?.review_round??1,status,all_passed:passed,owner_approval_required:true,paid_calls_executed:false,quality_claim:false,reviewer_count:a.length,missing_or_duplicate_roles:missing,verdicts,next_action:status==='CHANGES_REQUESTED'?'return_top_gap_to_original_builder':status==='AWAITING_OWNER_APPROVAL'?'wait_for_owner_approval':'do_not_dispatch_paid_models; complete FastAPI gates and media inspector'}}];
